title: Notification Authentication
description: Legacy authentication selector on a notification subscription: presence asks the seller for Bearer or HMAC-SHA256, and absence selects the profile `signing_profile` names. Deprecated and removed in AdCP 4.0. Unlike `core/webhook-authentication.json`, `credentials` is optional: the subscription is echoed on reads, and credentials are write-only and MUST NOT be echoed.

credentials.description: Credentials for the legacy scheme. Bearer: token. HMAC-SHA256: shared secret. Minimum 32 characters. Exchanged out-of-band during onboarding. Write-only.
